cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Brighter Side
cards.instruction: Meet every setback with even greater optimism.

mechanism: A imitates a gardening action incorrectly and answers each exposure of harm with a larger optimistic reinterpretation.
confusable: D17 sells a future bad plan; D20 greets actual setbacks with increasing optimism, through S04's refusal to admit confusion.
comparison: Garden loss and replanting versus performance cancellation.
seedUse: D20-a keeps successive setbacks tied to one physical situation rather than arbitrary new problems.
